_comment: Curated facts for fleet-apps-sheet-sync.mjs that no registry file carries.  The sync reads this file; edit it, then re-run the sync.  Never put a secret value here, only names and paths.  Each fact names its owner ruling or source.

6820885210.action: Successor Usage Monitor Local app, in progress under the Simple With Us (SWU) domain with a slightly changed name.  It replaces usage-local (Usage Local Monitor, 6799230729).  Owner Oct 11.  Its bundle id and App Store data stay as they are.

6820881005.action: Successor Usage Monitor Client app, in progress under the Simple With Us (SWU) domain with a slightly changed name.  It replaces usage (Usage Client Monitor, 6799230435).  Owner Oct 11.  Its bundle id and App Store data stay as they are.

appNotes.usage: Being replaced by the successor Usage Monitor Client app (ASC 6820881005, SWU domain, in progress; owner Oct 11).
appNotes.usage-local: Being replaced by the successor Usage Monitor Local app (ASC 6820885210, SWU domain, in progress; owner Oct 11).

seatPlatforms.GROK-WEB: Grok on the web and iOS

JET.notes: Its own identity, never a Codex default.  Wake-eligible (AFC #387) and bridged through the hosted MCP Worker (AFC #394, #403).  Its wake POSTs to https://agent-sync.jays.services/internal/wake/JET, which sends an OpenAI MCP Events zulip.mention to every subscribed ChatGPT chat (scripts/agent_sync/server/listener.toml).

INSTINCT.notes: Hosted seat (AFC #426, #427).  Echo is its partner bot; the two may merge.

ECHO.notes: Hosted seat, Instinct's partner bot (AFC #426, #427).  It may be retired when the two merge.

macWake.CLAUDE: Mac listener:  live delivery, and a fresh headless claude -p wake.  Live-session rewake is off (rewake_verified = false).
macWake.*: Mac listener:  inbox capture, no wake.

unheldWake.OPENCODE: Not held by a listener yet:  the Mac listener holds it once Jay enables it.

linearKeysMissing.GROK-WEB: Its Linear app keys are not in Infisical yet (checked Oct 11), so it signs as the shared Fleet app.
